role: offline physical upper bound with independent unit inventories and shared site power
registration_context: V3 control outcomes and free-start forced-run capacity bounds observed; no joint physical LP outcomes observed

asset.name: Pillswood site simulation
asset.power_basis: 98 MW published combined grid connection; impose sum of absolute unit powers <=98 MW as a conservative simulation throughput bound, not measured inverter throughput
asset.energy_basis: 196 MWh site capacity; equal 98 MWh usable allocation per BM unit is a simulation assumption, not measured unit capacity
asset.identity_basis: retained 2026 Elexon reference names Pillswood 1 and Pillswood 2; current 49.9 MW registry fields do not set historical unit limits

windows.population: all complete windows inside each fixed ten-day development sample; common reset inventory per diagnostic window

data_access: same cached P1/P2 2024 records only; no new requests or 2025 data

controls.inventory: two independent stocks, no transfer; preserve exact signed BOA energies and charge/discharge conversion
controls.baseline: one signed constant power per unit per half-hour; received BOAs override separately; joint sum of absolute nominations <=98 MW
controls.execution_power: sum of absolute executed unit powers <=98 MW continuously, including mixtures of baseline and BOA
controls.information: LP knows every future instruction for the current window; independent per-window schedules are not a shared causal policy

formulation.rate: r[u,j] is signed idle-time inventory rate; import power = -r/eta_charge when r>=0, export power = -r*eta_discharge otherwise
formulation.absolute_power: auxiliary a[u,j]>=r[u,j]/eta_charge and a[u,j]>=-r[u,j]*eta_discharge; sum_u a[u,j]<=site power
formulation.inventory: S[u,j]+forced_SOC_change(t)+idle_hours(t)*r[u,j] lies within unit capacity, using segment boundaries and zero crossings
formulation.forced_headroom: a[idle unit,j]<=site power - maximum absolute opposite-unit BOA power while the unit is idle
formulation.coupled_forced_power: check both-active BOAs against site bound before solving
formulation.initial_state: S[u,0]=unit_capacity[u]*0.5; first two half-hour rates zero

replay.required: independent minute reconstruction and chronological zero-split replay of every LP witness
checks: common initial stock and first-hour zero nominations
replay.unresolved: retain solver timeout/failure or witness discrepancy separately; never count as feasible
replay.coverage: every V3 successful window must be contained in the replayed physical-feasibility set

next_action: if the physical upper bound cannot meet 95% in April, hold this frozen application model; if a sufficient physical population exists, address causal control and candidate coverage before any source-benefit comparison
scope: simulation feasibility under the frozen equal capacity allocation, efficiency and conservative gross-power assumptions; no field-performance or causal/source advantage claim
